properties: exact producer and consumer Git commits
complete role lists including explicitly unavailable artifacts
separate semantic fingerprints and physical SHA-256 identities
candidate scores remain provisional raw evidence rather than probabilities
review sampling and inclusion probability remain explicit

geographic candidates and missing baseline do not imply occurrence or absence

database IDs, reviewer identity, service-role ingestion, grants and RLS remain downstream-owned
